Regia Engine is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`LICENSE`). It is built with the open-source crates below,
each used under the licence shown. Where a crate offers a choice of licences (`A OR B`), Regia Engine
uses it under any one of them. Packaged builds include the full licence texts and copyright
notices of these crates (`docs/specs/21-tooling-and-packaging.md`).

Fonts: egui's default fonts (`epaint_default_fonts`, editor only) include fonts under the Ubuntu
Font Licence 1.0 and the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The fonts Regia Engine bundles itself (the runtime UI's,
the editor's and the manual's) and its other bundled third-party files are listed with their
copyright lines and licence texts under "Bundled fonts and assets" below; their licence files
also ship beside them.

## Locale data (Unicode CLDR)

The culture formatting table of `regia_ui::loc_format` (`crates/regia_ui/src/loc_format/data.rs`: number
symbols and patterns, currency symbols, month and weekday names, date and time patterns, list and
relative-time patterns) is a small subset typed in by hand from the Unicode Common Locale Data
Repository (CLDR) charts, used under the Unicode License v3 (ADR-2698). It is not a copy of the CLDR
files.

## Optional Intel XeSS Super Resolution runtime

Builds enabling XeSS (ADR-4656) must distribute Intel's unmodified libxess.dll with the
SDK's LICENSE.txt (Intel Simplified Software License, Version October 2022) and
third-party-programs.txt. The SDK and generated bindings are not part of this repository.
SDK bundle: 3.0.2, https://github.com/intel/xess/releases/tag/v3.0.2.
